T: Bring a fork. Don't comb your hair with it.
D: A mermaid princess trades her voice for legs to find the prince she rescued.
P: Serve the mains when Ariel and Eric look through his collection at the castle.
S: Mango, pineapple and papaya wedges with passionfruit and lime

Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit cut and piled on a platter, squeezed with lime, scattered with chilli salt, with a dinglehopper each. Cut 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya into wedges and pile on a platter with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli flakes. Serve in the Caribbean sun.
smoked salmon blinis with dill crème fraîche, chive cream cheese rounds, for Ariel's first dinner

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and cucumber rounds with cream cheese. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig. Cut 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds. Beat 150g cream cheese with lemon zest, chopped chives and pepper and pipe onto the cucumber. Top with a few capers. Arrange everything on a silver tray with lemon wedges.
Thin fried green plantain chips with a coriander and lime sour cream dip
Green plantains sliced thin, fried at 180C until crisp, salted and served with a lime and coriander dip.
M: Grilled chicken thighs in an allspice, thyme, chilli and lime paste, with rice
Chicken thighs marinated in allspice, thyme, chilli, lime and spring onion, grilled until charred, with rice and peas.
Lagoon garlic lime prawns and coconut rice
prawns charred in chilli butter over creamy jasmine, eaten while Sebastian sings Kiss the Girl

Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter until charred, served over coconut rice cooked with a pinch of salt. Rinse 1.5 cups jasmine rice and cook with a 400ml tin coconut milk, 200ml water and half a teaspoon salt, covered on low for 15 minutes, then rest 10. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and the zest of 1 lime. Toss 1kg peeled green prawns with oil and grill on high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pour over the garlic butter and lime juice and serve on the rice with coriander.
W: Blue jelly with mango and kiwi fish inside. Ursula keeps voices in shells.

Blue jelly set in clear glasses with fruit fish shapes inside, topped with whipped cream foam. Cut mango and kiwifruit into little fish shapes. Make up 2 packets of blue jelly and pour into clear glasses with the fruit fish suspended inside. Chill 3 hours, then top with whipped cream like sea foam.
K: Coconut water and pineapple juice over ice with mint and lime

Coconut water and pineapple juice with lime and mint over ice, served in shell-shaped glasses. Fill tall glasses with ice and mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir and serve cold, the kind of drink you would trade your voice for.
